content.text: The search rate limit in `docs/limits.md` is out of date: production allows 120 requests per minute now. Update the doc.

# API limits

Limits are per API key. Bursts above the limit get HTTP 429.

| Endpoint | Limit | Burst | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /items` | 600/min | 50 | cached at edge |
| `POST /items` | 60/min | 10 | idempotency key required |
| `GET /search` | 60/min | 20 | `q` max 256 chars \| no wildcards |
| `POST /export` | 5/hour | 1 | async; poll `/jobs` |

Contact support to raise a limit.

I changed the `GET /search` limit in `docs/limits.md` from `60/min` to `120/min`. Nothing else in the row changed. That includes the escaped `\|` in the Notes cell, which keeps the table rendering correctly.

I left the burst value at 20 because you only mentioned the per-minute rate. If production raised the burst too, that number needs updating as well.

`docs/changelog.md` already has an entry for this ("2026-09: search limit raised in production."), so I didn't change it.
